summary: Revalidated GE Vernova with current SEC-filed Q2 2026 evidence, a fresh USD 996.57 market mark, and current USD/EUR data. Record orders, USD 176 billion backlog, margin expansion, cash generation, and net liquidity confirm direct power-bottleneck exposure. evidence.source: GE Vernova Q2 2026 earnings release filed with the SEC
evidence.claim: Q2 orders were USD 24.2 billion, backlog reached USD 176 billion, revenue was USD 11.1 billion, adjusted EBITDA was USD 1.2 billion, and free cash flow was USD 5.1 billion. Management raised 2026 revenue guidance to USD 45.5-46.5 billion and free-cash-flow guidance to USD 11.5-12.5 billion while retaining approximately USD 400 million of Wind EBITDA losses.

At June 30, cash and restricted cash were USD 13.120 billion, long-term borrowings were USD 2.794 billion, and Q2 diluted weighted-average shares were 270 million. The filing defines backlog as remaining performance obligations excluding orders cancellable without substantive penalty and identifies working capital as a material contributor to free cash flow.

Base upside is below the configured 20% margin-of-safety requirement.
